message.content: {"caption":"Eight-panel scatterplot comparing A-mem and Base memory embeddings across Dialogues 3–10.","description":"The target is a grid of eight scatterplots, arranged three in each of the first two rows and two centered in the last row. Each panel is labeled with a dialogue number and has a legend identifying blue dots as A-mem and red dots as Base. The numeric axes have no printed axis titles; the plotted coordinates are t-SNE embedding positions. There are no arrows, connecting lines, or check/cross marks. In all panels the red Base points form a relatively broad, diffuse cloud, while the blue A-mem points tend to gather into more compact local clusters, although the colors overlap and the degree of separation varies. Dialogue 3 has several blue groupings in the upper and lower parts of the cloud; Dialogue 4 shows conspicuous separated blue patches at the left, top, and right/lower portions; Dialogue 5 has a broad, overlapping blue distribution with less distinct separation. Dialogue 6 has clear blue patches across the upper, central-left, and lower-right areas. Dialogue 7 shows several blue clusters, including upper, lower, and right-side patches. Dialogue 8 has a prominent upper-left blue cluster and smaller central and lower groupings. Dialogue 9 has localized blue patches around the left, upper, and lower-right areas. Dialogue 10 has blue concentrations in the left, upper-central, and lower portions, within a broadly overlapping cloud. Axis ranges and tick spacing vary by panel; plotted values below are approximate visual read-offs of representative marks, not printed labels.
